No upper limit; offeror (Kamgras 1 Corp, EQT-backed) intends to acquire all shares, making Kakaku.com non-public. title_en: Notice Regarding Extension of Tender Offer Period for Shares of Kakaku.com, Inc. (TSE Code: 2371) by Kamgras 1 Corporation
translation_en_brief:
On 2 July 2026, Kamgras 1 Corporation (the offeror, majority-backed by EQT) announced an extension of its tender offer for Kakaku.com Inc. (TSE Code: 2371) from its original end date to 16 July 2026, increasing the total tender period to 47 business days. The offer began on 13 May 2026.

The minimum tender threshold remains 34,941,000 shares (17.51% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury). No upper limit is set; the offeror intends to acquire all shares and make Kakaku.com non-public. The extension was decided after assessing post-commencement market price movements, shareholder and warrant-holder subscription status, and forward subscription outlook. The stated purpose is to provide shareholders and warrant holders a further opportunity to decide on tendering and to increase the likelihood of successful completion. The offeror may establish one or more Japanese subsidiaries under Kamgras Limited as parent after settlement closes.
